subject: MAP & provisioning corridor for DataWave pilot — assets, gating, and takedown
messages:
From: Sara Lim <sara@datawave.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@datawave.ai
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: MAP & test asset onramp — DataWave pilot

Hi Camila,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're excited to move forward with a short pilot to validate latency/cost on our retail QA flows. To keep things moving on our side procurement asked for the following so we can approve sandbox access:

- A mutual action plan (high level milestones & owners) that includes delivery of prompt packs and a small test-case corpus.
- Clear usage constraints (ephemeral-only, no redistribution, deletion confirmation).
- A timeline for provisioning + takedown.

We can provide an initial prompt pack and manifest but need your preferred transfer method (SFTP, AWS share, or presigned S3) and a redlined MAP to sign.

Can you send a draft MAP and an outline of the operational steps? Our target kickoff window is week of Jan 25.

Thanks,
Sara Lim
Program Manager, DataWave Analytics
---
Note: procurement can be looped in for DocuSign once the MAP is finalized.

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lim <sara@datawave.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 10:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: MAP & test asset onramp — DataWave pilot

Hi Sara —

Appreciate the clear asks. I've attached a compact MAP draft that maps milestones to owners and a provisional cadence (see attachment: redwood-mpa-draft.xlsx). High level here:

1) Provisioning (Jan 25–29)
   - Redwood provides ephemeral sandbox + model routing config (owner: Camila)
   - DataWave delivers promptpack and manifest (owner: DataWave)
2) Acceptance sprint (Feb 1–11)
   - Joint smoke tests + quality checks; acceptance criteria listed in MAP
3) Pilot run (Feb 14–Mar 4)
   - Performance and cost monitoring; weekly syncs
4) Takedown (within 7 days of contract end or on-demand)
   - Confirm deletion and provide audit log export (owner: Redwood infra)

Usage constraints (proposal):
- Ephemeral-only access: prompt packs/testcases may be used inside the sandbox only.
- No redistribution or derivative dataset publication.
- Retention: artifacts stored only for 30 days post-pilot then purged unless an extension is agreed.

Attachments referenced: redwood-mpa-draft.xlsx (MAP with milestone owners and acceptance criteria).

Operational transfer options:
- Preferred: presigned S3 link to a dedicated bucket (Redwood provides upload credentials scoped to a short window).
- Alternatives: SFTP or secure share (slower).

Next steps: please confirm transfer method and whether your procurement prefers a DocuSign envelope (we can send once redlines are done). If Jan 25 kickoff still looks good, we should lock the MAP by Jan 20.

Thanks — looping Ben for licensing language and Karthik for provisioning timeline.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai

[attachment: redwood-mpa-draft.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lim <sara@datawave.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 08:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: MAP & test asset onramp — DataWave pilot

Sara/Camila — quick pass from Legal/Commercial on usage constraints and a lightweight clause suggestion to insert into the MAP: 

Suggested clause (short form):
- "Evaluation Assets" (prompt packs, test cases, manifests) are provided for the sole purpose of evaluating Redwood's hosted inference in the ephemeral sandbox for the Pilot. Recipient shall not copy, redistribute, or incorporate Evaluation Assets into derivative datasets or model-training corpora. All Evaluation Assets must be securely deleted within 30 days of pilot termination; Redwood will provide a deletion confirmation report.

Operational notes:
- We require an eval_manifest.csv listing file-level checksums and a contact for transfer troubleshooting.
- If DataWave needs an extended retention window, that becomes a commercial item and we should capture it in the deal.

Attachments we expect from DataWave: eval_manifest.csv, promptpack_v1.zip. Please include checksums in the manifest.

Happy to accept small redlines; anything that broadens reuse or retention will need a short SOW.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
[attachment: sample-usage-clause.txt (text, 2KB)]

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Sara Lim <sara@datawave.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 11:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: MAP & test asset onramp — DataWave pilot

Adding ops detail so we have an operational playbook in the MAP: 

- Transfer: presigned S3 upload to a scoped Redwood bucket. We will create a one-time presigned PUT link valid for 72 hours. 
- Staging: files land in a quarantined folder; automated checksum + malware scan runs within 10 minutes of upload.
- Labeling: ingest pipeline will tag files as "eval:DataWave-DW-2027-042" for traceability.
- Access: only sandbox-serving nodes will mount the eval assets; no snapshotting into persistent model stores.
- Audit & takedown: on takedown we will run a deletion job and publish an audit artifact (JSON) with timestamps and operator id.

Proposed dates to match Camila's MAP: presigned link available Jan 25; upload window Jan 25–27; automated scans and staging complete by Jan 28. If that works for DataWave we can add these lines into the MAP spreadsheet.

On a separate note: please confirm whether testcases include PII. If yes, we will require an explicit data handling addendum.

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Platform Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Sara Lim <sara@datawave.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@datawave.ai
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2027 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: MAP & test asset onramp — DataWave pilot

Camila/Priyom/Ben — thanks, this looks good and is actionable. A few confirmations from our side: 

- Transfer method: presigned S3 is fine. We will upload promptpack_v1.zip and a manifest (eval_manifest.csv) that includes SHA256 checksums.
- PII: none of the testcases contain customer PII; manifest will include a dataset-level attribute confirming this.
- Timeline: Jan 25 upload window works; we accept the 30-day post-pilot retention and the deletion confirmation report.

Procurement note: we can sign a redlined MAP via DocuSign. Please send the envelope and I'll loop procurement over the signature. DocuSign link for the envelope we will sign: https://docusign.net/link/ABC123-DataWave-MPA

I will have procurement attach the manifest this week (expect by Jan 22). Once you send the presigned link on the 25th we'll proceed with the upload.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Sara Lim
Program Manager, DataWave Analytics
[signed: Sara Lim]
